precision_basis: No biological effect margin or sample-size guarantee is invented; show every unit and sensitivity without a confirmation threshold.
amendment_reason: New exposed extension; earlier frozen outputs and scientific criteria remain unchanged.
question: Does the fixed lesion residual add internal patient-held-out paired tissue discrimination beyond fixed shared-remodelling and stress modules?
decision: Evaluate internal conditional measurement utility before considering any further independent validation; retain no-gain and instability outcomes.
strongest_rival: Residual performance may reflect changed epithelial composition, generic stress or historical outcome-informed choices rather than lesion-specific biology.
discriminator: Leave one whole patient pair out, using the identical fixed baseline with and without the residual; no cells or specimens from that patient enter scaling or coefficient estimation.
exposure_record: Kim outcomes and original signed-rank results were read before this comparison was selected. Fixed gene lists originated in distinct 23-patient GSE308103 discovery before the original Kim score run, but this is not untouched confirmation or validation of the historical feature-discovery pipeline.
biological_unit: Eight source-supported paired patients; each contains normal-AT2 and author-labelled tumour epithelial pseudobulks.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells form pseudobulks nested in samples and patients. Eight folds share training patients and are not independent model-training experiments. This reuses the original Kim cohort.
population_and_selection: Exactly the eight original test_v2 patient pairs, author labels, selected cell counts and 29634-gene universe; no new subtype or cell-floor selection.
contrast: Paired conditional logistic baseline shared_remodelling plus HALLMARK_P53_PATHWAY, HALLMARK_HYPOXIA, HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE versus addition of lesion_specific. Separate addition of stress_excluded is sensitivity.
endpoint: Equal-patient mean held-out pair log loss, baseline minus augmented gain, all patient gains, and chance log(2) reference; contemporaneous tissue discrimination, not later outcome.
methods: Rebuild fixed pseudobulk counts from raw UMI and annotations; require original library-size parity. Scores are fixed-module mean log2(CPM+1) with full per-sample count denominator. No cross-patient TMM. Fit paired conditional logistic regression without intercept, L2 penalty lambda=1 primary and 0.1/10 sensitivities; training-only population SD across fourteen training samples, zero SD replaced by one; BFGS gradient tolerance 1e-7 with independent Newton coefficients agreeing within 1e-6. No feature search, held-out centering or tuning.
missingness_and_exclusions: Fail on duplicate/missing cells, changed group counts, missing/empty/duplicate module genes, altered full-gene universe/library totals, nonfinite scores or failed optimization. Retain all eight patients and all penalties.
multiplicity: One primary baseline-versus-lesion comparison at lambda=1; stress-excluded and lambda=.1/10 are displayed sensitivities. No p-values, biological CIs or model selection by favorable sensitivity.
interpretation_limit: Internal prediction conditional on exposed choices and fixed features. Normal AT2 versus author tumour epithelium changes population composition. No cancer specificity, future fate, malignant identity, causation or external transport claim.
stop_rule: Fail closed on input/identity/arithmetic/optimizer checks. Report all outcomes including worse-than-baseline or chance; do not change features, penalty, patient set or scoring after exposure.
